blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.
blocks.zh: 在自身故障上精细地调整视觉语言模型是直接修复的方法,但被搁置故障的准确性,明显的衡量成功,误导. 许多被开采出故障不是模型错误:对Quen3-VL-8B-Instruction的100起故障进行人力审计,发现COCO和GQA产生的问题有37起标签错误. 而被布雷的故障分享了措辞的规律性:只有问题分类器在73.2%被搁置的故障对上得到两个正确的答案. 我们研究了两个有经过核实的故障驱动修复(VFR)的陷阱:打入了最小-pair故障挖掘,由三名LLM判断员进行校验,在没有看到所储存的标签的情况下进行回答,回答第一的校正目标,以及LORA用重放来微调. VFR修复 82.8%的被搁置故障(基准模型:10.0 %),在独立标注的无条件对子上,通过空间关系将总体精度从87.4%提高到92.4%,即使措辞指向错误答案,其精度也从66.7%上升到96.8%. 然而,在对88.9%的被搁置故障进行修复的否定中,对无条件对子的准确性从88.7%下降到79.7%:它打破了对缺失物体的否定,这在它的训练中是罕见的。 未经核实,无条件配对的精确度降至80.8%,低于基准模型的87.4%,通过一个否定的捷径,我们的发展基准被错过;没有选择失败,它保持在92.0%(1个种子),而修理则下降到73.4%。 培训还降低了双相关系准确度(74.3%至49.6%);仅重播数据:48.4%;多相关系重播部分且不均匀地扭转了这种情况。 解释空间问题保留了大部分收益(87.3%对基准模型的62.0%),尽管重新措辞将搁置故障的空间修复率从92.9%降至76.8%。 在What's Up的独立照片中, 标注选择仍然完美, 而我们的"是"/"不是"对"的准确度从84.5%下降到26.4%。

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) answer open-ended questions about images fluently, yet still fail simple, typed questions: whether an object is present, what color it is, which side of another object it is on, how many there are, or whether a negated statement holds [ 29 , 38 , 19 , 28 , 45 , 4 , 52 ] .
For a given model these failures are systematic.
We generated 2.5 million minimal pairs (two yes/no questions about one image that differ in a single factor) from COCO and GQA annotations [ 30 , 23 ] ; Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 5 ] was scored wrong on at least one question of 22.2% of the pairs, and of 53.7% of the spatial-relation pairs.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)能流利地回答关于图像的开放式问题,然而仍然失败的简单,打出的问题:一个物体是否在,它是什么颜色,它在另一个物体的哪一边,有多少,或者一个否定的语句是否持有[29,38,19,28,45,4,52].
对于一个特定的模型来说,这些失败是系统性的。
我们从COCO和GQA注释[30,23]中生成了250万对最小对(两个关于一个单一因数不同图像的回答是/否);Qune3-VL-8B-Instructionct [5]在至少一个对对22.2%和53.7%的空间关系对数上被打错了.

blocks.en:
Most remedies are model-agnostic.
Robust instruction data [ 31 ] , preference training [ 50 , 47 ] , and contrastive decoding [ 27 , 22 ] target hallucination in general, and minimal-change training sets such as VisMin [ 4 ] are built without reference to what a particular model gets wrong.
Recent work instead builds training data from a model’s own errors, by synthesizing examples that target its reasoning failures [ 42 ] or by turning its hallucinated responses into preference pairs [ 33 ] .
The simplest version of this idea is to mine a model’s failures on typed questions and train on them directly.
We find that it can repair spatial relations but has two traps.
First, many mined failures are not model errors.
In a human audit of 100 mined failures, only 45 were clear model errors; 37 had a stored label that the image contradicts, and 18 were ambiguous.
Training on such pairs teaches the model to contradict the image.
Second, the natural measure of success, repair accuracy (the share of held-out failures answered correctly after training), overstates what training repairs.
Mined failures share regularities in their wording, so much of repair accuracy can be earned without the image: classifiers that see only the question text, trained on our training failures, get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs.
And held-out failures rarely contain what training breaks: our verified model repairs 88.9% of held-out negation failures, yet on unconditioned, human-labeled pairs its negation accuracy falls from 88.7% to 79.7%.
blocks.zh:
大多数补救措施都是模型不可知论的。
强力指令数据[31],偏好训练[50,47],以及对比解码[27,22] 目标幻觉一般,VisMin[4]等最小变化训练集的建设没有提及特定模型的失误.
相反,最近的工作从模型本身的错误中积累了培训数据,将针对其推理失败的例子合成[42],或者将其幻觉中的反应变成偏好对[33]。
这个想法最简单的版本是去排除模型在打字题上的故障,并直接对其进行训练.
我们发现它可以修复空间关系,但有两个陷阱。
首先,许多埋设的故障不是模型错误。
在对100次地雷故障进行人的审计中,只有45次是明显的模型错误;37次有存储的标签,表明图像有矛盾,18次模棱两可。
关于这种对子的训练教导模型与图像相矛盾.
第二,衡量成功与否的自然标准,修复的准确性(培训后被搁置的故障比例得到正确答复),过分说明了培训的修复内容。
矿井故障在措辞上都具有规律性, 所以没有图像就可以获得许多修复精度: 分类员只看到问题文本, 训练我们训练失败,
而被搁置的失败很少包含什么培训中断:我们经核实的模型修复88.9%被搁置的否定失败,然而在毫无条件的人类标记的对子上,其否定的准确性从88.7%下降到79.7%。

blocks.en:
We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR, Fig. 1 ), a deliberately simple pipeline.
We mine typed minimal pairs on which the target model fails, and three LLM judges answer the two questions of a mined pair from the image without seeing the stored labels; the pair is kept only if their majority answers agree with them.
Each verified question receives an answer-first corrective target rendered deterministically from the verified annotation ( e.g . , “No, there is one truck, not six.”), and we fine-tune with LoRA [ 21 ] on these pairs mixed one-to-one with general instructions, whose open-ended answers are the base model’s own.
Because repair accuracy alone misleads, we evaluate on five tiers: repair on held-out failures next to a question-only classifier, a blind diagnostic with a black image, a gold test of unconditioned pairs labeled blind by a human and split by whether the wording alone points to the right answer, four held-out benchmarks registered in advance, and five development benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们用经过核实的故障驱动修复(VFR,图1)来研究两个陷阱,这是故意简单的管道.
我们的地雷打入了目标模型失败的最小对数,三名LLM评委在未看到所储存的标签的情况下从图像中解答了两个地雷对数的问题;只有在他们多数的答复都同意的情况下,才保留对数。
每个经核实的问题都得到第一个答案的纠正目标,从经核实的注释中确定(例如, " 不,有一辆卡车,不是六辆 " ),我们与LORA[21]对这些对联进行微调,将一对一与一般指示混为一对,而基本模型自己的答案是开放式的。
因为仅修复精度就误导了我们,我们从五个层次来评估:在仅问分类器旁边的被搁置故障的修复,一个带有黑色图像的盲诊诊断,一个被人类贴上盲目标签的无条件对子的黄金测试,以及用单词是否指向正确的答案来划分,四个被搁置的基准提前登记,以及五个发展基准.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are empirical findings about this setting: • A verified repair recipe that raises accuracy on independently labeled pairs. VFR repairs 82.8% of image-disjoint held-out failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (base model 10.0%; TEST: 82.9%), against 27.0% for VisMin minimal-change data with the same budget and recipe.
On gold it gains 5.0 points (95% interval 2.5–7.5), a gain that comes from spatial relations (66.7 → \to 96.8%), which improve even where the wording points to the wrong answer.
On held-out benchmarks registered in advance, it gains 2.9 points on CV-Bench 2D and loses 3.3 on BLINK. • Mined failures need verification. Training on unverified mined failures repairs 6.8 points less and teaches a negation shortcut that none of our development benchmarks detects: on unconditioned gold pairs, the unverified model falls below the base model (80.8% vs . 87.4%; VFR: 92.4%) and answers 4.0% of negations about absent objects correctly (base model: 88.0%). • Repair accuracy overstates repair. Where the wording points to the wrong answer, gold spatial accuracy rises from 70.8% to 97.5%, but pooled over all five types VFR shows no clear gain over the base model, and its negation repair on held-out failures hides a loss on gold, concentrated in negations about absent objects (88.0 → \to 65.9%), which are rare in its training data.
Selecting failures adds 8.5 points of TEST repair over verified pairs drawn regardless of failure, but only 0.8 on gold (interval − 0.8 -0.8 to 2.5; seed 42).
Recipes with equal repair also differ in their answer prior and in how much they answer from the question alone. • Fine-tuning degrades an untrained task. Two-image relation accuracy on VisMin falls from 74.3% to 49.6% (five seeds), and to 48.4% with the replay data alone, as the model picks the same image for opposite captions; over five seeds, describing both images first recovers 10.7 points on average (6.1 to 15.4) and multi-image replay 12.4 (2.6 to 28.9) at essentially no repair cost.
On held-out BLINK, its two-image tasks fall by 10.8 points on average. • The spatial gain is largest on above/below and carries over in part. On gold, above/below accuracy rises from 42.9% to 95.6%, while left/right was already at 91.8%; with paraphrased gold questions VFR keeps most of its gain across both axes (87.3% vs . the base model’s 62.0%), while rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%, and CV-Bench 2D’s gain is partly in counting.
On What’sUp’s controlled photos, caption choice stays at the base model’s level (97.7% vs . 97.6%), but every arm trained on our pairs answers our yes/no questions about objects under others worse (VFR: from the base model’s 84.5% to 26.4% of photos). Code, data, prompts, and the registered protocols will be released.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是对这一背景的实证结论:一种经过核实的修理方法,可以提高独立标签的对子的准确性。 VFR修复了Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的82.8%的图像断开故障(基础型号为10.0%;TEST:82.9%),而VisMin的最小变化数据是27.0%,预算和配方相同。
在黄金上,它得到5.0分(95%的间隔2.5-7.5),这一收益来自空间关系(66.7 ~\=96.8 %),即使措辞指向错误的答案也有所改善。
在预先登记的搁置基准上,它在CV-Bench 2D上获得2.9分,在BLINK上损失3.3分. • 地雷故障需要核查。 关于未验证的开采故障的培训减少了6.8分,并教导了一个否定的捷径,我们的发展基准没有发现:在无条件的黄金对上,未验证的模型低于基准模型(80.8%对87.4%;VFR:92.4%),并且正确回答4.0%对缺失对象的否定(基准模型:88.0%)。 • 修理准确度过高。 当措辞指向错误的答案时,黄金空间精度从70.8%升至97.5%,但所有五种类型的VFR集合显示对基准模型没有明显的收益,其对被搁置故障的否定修复掩盖了黄金的损失,集中在对缺失对象的否定(88.0~\~65.9%),这在培训数据中是罕见的.
选择失败会增加8.5分的TEST修复,而不论是否失败,都比所绘制的经核实的对对多,但在黄金上只增加了0.8分(中间−0.8-0.8至2.5;种子42)。
得到同等修理的食谱在答复之前和答复中也存在差异,它们单从问题中解答了多少。 • 支助 微调会降低未受过训练的任务。 VisMin上的双像关系精度从74.3%下降到49.6%(5种种子),仅重播数据就下降到48.4%,因为模型为相反的字幕选择了相同的图像;超过5个种子,描述两个图像首先平均恢复了10.7分(6.1至15.4),多像重播12.4分(2.6至28.9),基本上没有修复费用.
在被搁置的BLINK中,其双像任务平均下降了10.8个百分点。 上面/下面的空间收益最大,并部分结转。 在黄金方面,上/下精度从42.9%升至95.6%,而左/右已经是91.8%;用解释性的金质问题,VFR将大部分收益保留在两轴上(87.3%对基准型号的62.0%),而将搁置故障的空间修复从92.9%改为76.8%,CV-Bench 2D的收益部分在计算中。
在What's Up的受控照片上,标题选择仍然停留在基模的水平(97.7%对97.6%),但每只训练我们配对的手臂都会回答关于他人更糟糕的物体的肯定/否定问题(VFR:从基模的84.5%到26.4%的照片). 代码、数据、提示和注册协议将公布。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Object hallucination is measured with caption metrics such as CHAIR [ 40 ] and with yes/no probes such as POPE [ 29 ] , whose label errors RePOPE corrects [ 38 ] ; AMBER [ 48 ] also covers attributes and relations.
Paired and adversarial benchmarks expose failures that aggregate scores hide: HallusionBench [ 19 ] , NaturalBench [ 28 ] , and MMVP [ 45 ] for fine-grained visual questions; Winoground [ 43 ] , SugarCrepe [ 20 ] , and What’sUp [ 24 ] for composition and spatial relations; NegBench [ 2 ] and NegVQA [ 52 ] for negation; and VisMin [ 4 ] for minimal visual changes.
Models can also answer many such questions from language priors alone [ 1 , 7 ] .
These works diagnose failures; we repair one model’s typed failures and use such benchmarks only for evaluation.
blocks.zh:
对象幻觉用诸如CHAIR [40] 等字幕测量,用如POPE [29] 等是/无探测器测量,其标签错误 RePOPE 校正 [38];AMBER [48] 也涵盖属性和关系.
Paired and openate basics 暴露了总分隐藏的失败:Hallusion Bench [19], Natural Bench [28], 和 MMVP [45] 为细微的视觉问题; Winoground [43], SugarCrepe [20], 和What's Up [24] 为组成和空间关系; Neg Bench [2] 和 NegVQA [52] 为否定; VisMin [4] 为最小的视觉变化。
模型还可以单从语言前缀[1,7]解答许多这样的问题.
这些工作诊断失败;我们修复了一个模型的打字失败,并且只使用这些基准进行评估。

blocks.en:
LRV-Instruction [ 31 ] adds negative and manipulated instructions to instruction tuning; RLHF-V [ 50 ] and mDPO [ 47 ] train on preferences; VCD [ 27 ] and OPERA [ 22 ] change decoding without training.
Closer to our setting, some methods build training data from the target model’s own errors: Stan et al . [ 42 ] have frontier models analyze a weaker multimodal model’s reasoning failures and generate filtered corrective examples, and OViP [ 33 ] builds preference pairs online from the model’s own hallucinated responses.
We study the simplest version, training directly on a model’s mined failures on typed questions, and analyze what it teaches.
blocks.zh:
LRV-指令 [31] 在指令调谐中添加了负面和被操纵的指令; RLHF-V [50] 和 mDPO [47] 列车在偏好上; VCD [27] 和 OPERA [22] 不经过培训而更改编码.
更接近我们的设定,一些方法从目标模型自己的错误中积累培训数据: Stan et al. [42] 有前沿模型分析一个较弱的多式联运模型的推理失败,并生成过滤的纠正性例子,OViP [33] 从模型本身的幻觉反应中在网上构建偏好对.
我们研究最简单的版本,直接培训一个模型在打字问题上的地雷故障,并分析它教的是什么。

blocks.en:
Contrast sets [ 14 ] and counterfactually augmented data [ 25 ] use minimal edits to probe and train text models.
VisMin [ 4 ] releases minimal-change image–caption data and fine-tunes CLIP and Idefics2 [ 26 ] on it; it is our main data baseline.
Slice discovery [ 11 ] and model patching [ 16 ] find and repair a given model’s systematic errors.
Label errors are common even in test sets [ 39 ] , including the COCO-derived POPE [ 38 ] ; mining a model’s failures selects for them, because a correct answer scored against a wrong label counts as a failure, and training then propagates them.
This motivates our verification step.
LLMs are widely used as judges [ 53 ] , and panels of different judges reduce single-model bias [ 46 ] .
Our committee is such a panel, but it answers each question from the image instead of grading a response.
blocks.zh:
Contrast set [14] 和反事实扩充数据 [25] 使用最小编辑来探测和训练文本模型.
VisMin [4] 发布最小变化的图像 - 封装数据并对 CLIP 和 Idefics 2 [26] 进行微调;这是我们的主要数据基线.
切片发现[11]和模型补丁[16]找到并修复给定模型的系统错误.
标签错误即使在测试集[39]中也是常见的,包括COCO衍生的POPE[38];开采模型的失败选择给他们,因为正确答案对错误的标签的分数算作失败,培训就加以宣传。
这促使我们采取核查步骤。
LLMs被广泛用作法官[53],不同法官组成的合议庭减少单型偏差[46].
我们的委员会是这样一个小组,但它从图像中回答每个问题,而不是给答复分级。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning multimodal LLMs can cause catastrophic forgetting [ 51 ] ; replaying earlier data [ 41 ] and training on the model’s own outputs [ 49 ] limit it.
We replay general instructions with the base model’s own responses as targets.
The side effect we report, a bare choice that often picks the same image for opposite captions, resembles shortcut learning [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
微调多式联运 LLMS可能导致灾难性的遗忘[51];重播早先的数据[41],以及对模型自身产出的培训[49]限制了它.
我们以基准模型本身的反应作为目标来重现一般指示。
我们报告的副作用,一个赤裸裸的选择,常常为相反标题选择相同的图像,类似于快捷学习[15].

blocks.en: 3 Verified failure-driven repair
blocks.zh: 3 核实故障驱动修复

blocks.en: 3.1 Typed minimal pairs
blocks.zh: 3.1 型号最小对

blocks.en:
A typed minimal pair ( I , q 1 , q 2 , a 1 , a 2 ) (I,q_{1},q_{2},a_{1},a_{2}) is an image I I with two yes/no questions that differ in a single factor and have opposite answers.
Each image–question pair is a cell , and a pair counts as correct only if both of its cells are.
We use five types (examples in Supp. A ). Object existence contrasts an annotated object with an absent one. Attribute swap contrasts an object’s color with a different color (“Is there a white drape in the image?” / “Is there a purple drape in the image?”). Spatial relation swaps left/right or above/below between two annotated objects in the image frame (“In the image, is there a car above a skateboard?” / “…below a skateboard?”). Counting contrasts the number of objects stated in a caption and matched by the instance annotations (1–9 in TRAIN) with a different number at most five away from it, as in “Is there exactly one toilet in the image?” / “Are there exactly six toilets in the image?”. Negation negates an existence, attribute, or relation fact about a present or an absent object (six operators; e.g . , “In the image, is there no toaster to the left of a knife?”).
Pairs are generated from COCO train2017 instances and captions [ 30 ] and from GQA scene graphs [ 23 ] .
Each pair stores its changed factor ( e.g . , the true and the asked color), from which its training targets are later rendered.
A model answers a cell with arg ​ max y ∈ { Yes , No } ​ log ​ P ​ ( y ∣ I , q ) \argmax_{y\in\{\texttt{Yes},\texttt{No}\}}\log P(y\mid I,q) at the first answer position, under a fixed instruction wrapper; ties, where the two log probabilities are within 10 − 8 \smash{10^{-8}} of each other, count as wrong.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mining the model’s failures
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 开采模型的失败

blocks.en:
We score Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the generated pairs with a one-word wrapper (“Answer the question using only one word: Yes or No.”; all wrappers in Supp. A ).
A pair is a mined failure if at least one of its cells disagrees with the stored label; there is no margin threshold, and pairs with a tie are excluded.
We mined in two rounds: 69,000 pairs, of which 25.3% failed, and 2.5M new pairs (500k per type), of which 22.2% failed.
Failure rates differ strongly by type, from 6.7% for counting to 53.7% for spatial relations in round two.
The verified pool has 15,000 pairs (3,000 per type), which we split into image-disjoint TRAIN, VAL, and TEST sets of 12,000, 1,500, and 1,500 pairs on 9,528, 1,336, and 1,330 distinct images, each balanced by type.
blocks.zh:
在生成的对子上,我们用一个字的包装器(“只用一个字回答问题:是或否;所有包装都用Supp.A.”)来评分。
如果至少一个单元格不同意所储存的标签,则一对就是被埋设的故障;没有比值阈值,而且没有带领带的对子。
我们分为两轮:69,000对,其中25.3%失败,2.5M新对(每型500k),其中22.2%失败.
按类型划分的失败率差异很大,第二轮空间关系的失败率从6.7%到53.7%。
经核实的游泳池有15,000对(每型3000对),我们分为图像分离的TRAIN,VAL,和TEST的12,000,1,500对,以及9,528,1,336和1,330个不同的图像,每组都按类型平衡.

blocks.en: 3.3 Committee verification
blocks.zh: 3.3 委员会的核查

blocks.en:
A mined failure is either a model error or a label problem, where the stored label disagrees with the image ( e.g . , a missed annotation or a wrong color).
Training on label problems teaches the model to contradict the image.
We therefore verify mined failures with three LLM judges: Claude Sonnet 5 [ 3 ] , Seed2.1 Pro [ 6 ] , and Gemini 3.6 Flash [ 17 ] .
Each judge answers each question separately from the image, with yes , no , or uncertain , and sees neither the stored label nor the model’s answer (prompt in Supp. B ).
A two-of-three majority decides each question.
A pair is kept only if both majorities agree with the stored labels.
It is dropped as a label disagreement if a majority contradicts a stored label, and as ambiguous if a question has no majority or an uncertain majority.
The committee is a filter, not ground truth: a label disagreement shows that the judges contradict the label, not that the model was right.
blocks.zh:
布雷失败要么是一个模型错误,要么是一个标签问题,存储的标签与图像不一致(例如,缺失的注释或错误的颜色).
关于标签问题的培训教模型与图像相矛盾.
因此,我们通过3名LLM法官核查了地雷的故障: Claude Sonnet 5 [3],种子2.1 Pro [6],和双子座3.6 Flash [17].
每个法官对每个问题都与图像分开回答,回答是、否、或不确定,既不看到存储的标签,也不看到模型的答案(提示见Supp.B)。
每个问题由三分之二多数决定。
只有在两个多数都同意所储存的标签的情况下,才保留一对。
如果多数与储存的标签相矛盾,则放弃该标签,如果问题没有多数或不确定多数,则取消该标签。
委员会是一个过滤器,而不是地面真理:标签上的分歧表明法官们与标签相矛盾,而不是模型是正确的.

blocks.en:
We sent the committee all round-one failures and a random sample of round-two ones, drawn per type until each type had at least 3,000 kept pairs.
Of these 45,430 failures, it kept 33.1%, flagged 57.8% as label disagreements, and found 9.0% ambiguous.
Keep rates range from 25.2% (object existence) to 39.5% (negation).
The committee keeps 72.5% of pairs drawn regardless of failure: 45.6% of the model’s failures and 88.7% of its successes, so mining concentrates the pairs it rejects.
Two human audits by one of the authors check the committee from both sides.
Before verification, 100 mined failures (20 per type) contained 45 model errors, 37 wrong labels (Wilson 95% CI [28.2, 46.8]), and 18 ambiguous pairs; an earlier version of the committee, with Gemini 3.5 Flash as the third judge, kept these model errors with 80% precision and 71% recall, and the final committee keeps them with 85.7% precision and 66.7% recall and rejects 36 of the 37 wrong labels (Supp. B ).
These pairs were the committee’s calibration set, so this is calibration evidence, not an independent test.
The base model’s own confidence cannot stand in for the committee: its AUROC for wrong labels is 0.76 on the audited pairs and 0.72 against the committee (Supp. B ).
After verification and target rendering, 100 training pairs had 88.0% correct target cells [83.0, 93.0] and 5.0% factually wrong ones [1.5, 9.0].
blocks.zh:
我们向委员会发送了所有第1轮失败和随机抽样的第2轮失败,每个类型抽取,直到每个类型至少有3000对保留.
在这45 430次失败中,它保留了33.1%,标注57.8%为标签分歧,并发现9.0%的模棱两可。
保持率从25.2%(对象存在)到39.5%(负数)不等.
无论失败与否,委员会保留了72.5%的配对:45.6%的模型失败,88.7%的成功,因此采矿集中了它拒绝的配对。
其中一名提交人进行了两次人文审查,从双方检查委员会。
在核查之前,100个地雷故障(每类20个)包含45个模型错误,37个错误标签(Wilson 95% CI [28.2,46.8)),以及18个模棱两可的对;委员会较早的版本,由双子座3.5 Flash担任第三名裁判,将这些模型错误保持了80%的精确度和71%的召回率,最终委员会保持了85.7%的精确度和66.7%的召回率,并拒绝37个错误标签中的36个(Supp.B.).
这些对是委员会校准的一套,所以这是校准证据,而不是独立的测试.
基准模型本身的信心不能代表委员会:其AUROC对错误的标签为经审计的对子0.76,对委员会0.72(Supp.B)。
经过核查和目标渲染,100对训练对有88.0%正确的目标细胞[83.0]和5.0%实际错误的目标细胞[1.5,9.0]。

blocks.en: 3.4 Corrective fact-grounded targets
blocks.zh: 3.4 基于事实的纠正目标

blocks.en:
The simplest training target for a yes/no cell is the bare answer.
We instead train with corrective targets that give the answer first and then the verified fact, rendered deterministically from the stored factor with eight templates per type (19 for negation); no LLM writes targets.
The counting pair above yields “Yes, the image shows one toilet.” and “No, there is one toilet, not six.”
Training uses a wrapper that asks for the answer and a one-sentence explanation (Supp. A ).
Every target begins with the same first token as the bare answer, so first-token scoring is unchanged (Supp. C ).

相反,我们用纠正目标来训练,首先给出答案,然后给出经核实的事实,从储存的系数中确定每个类型有8个模板(用于否定);没有LLM书写目标。

blocks.en: 3.5 Training with self-replay
blocks.zh: 3.5 进行自我反思的培训

blocks.en:
We fine-tune with LoRA [ 21 ] on an equal mix of repair pairs and replay rows, ℒ = 1 2 ​ 𝔼 p ​ [ ℒ pair ] + 1 2 ​ 𝔼 r ​ [ ℒ replay ] \mathcal{L}=\tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathbb{E}_{p}[\mathcal{L}_{\text{pair}}]+\tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathbb{E}_{r}[\mathcal{L}_{\text{replay}}] ,
where a replay row’s loss is its token mean and the end-of-turn token is not supervised in either part.
The 12,000 replay rows come from eight categories (Supp. D ): descriptions of LLaVA and COCO images (33%); open-ended VQA from LLaVA [ 32 ] and non-binary VQAv2 [ 18 ] (26%); balanced VQAv2 yes/no questions (24%); Dolly text-only instructions [ 8 ] (8%); ChartQA [ 36 ] (5%); ScienceQA [ 35 ] (3%); and small negation and counting yes/no sets (0.6%).
Descriptions, open-ended VQA, and text-only instructions (8,020 rows) use the frozen base model’s own greedy responses as targets, so replay ties the model to its own behavior rather than to another model’s style; the other categories keep their dataset answers.
LoRA (rank 32, α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , dropout 0.05) adapts the attention and MLP projections of all 36 language-model layers (87.3M trainable parameters, 1.0% of the model); the vision encoder and projector stay frozen.
We train for one epoch, 1,500 updates of 8 repair pairs and 8 replay rows, with AdamW, learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} , 45 warm-up updates, cosine decay, and gradient clipping at 1.0; training takes 4.1 hours on one 48 GB GPU.

blocks.en:
We repair Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 5 ] at a pinned revision in bf16 (Supp. F ).
All arms share its tokenizer, processor, and image-resolution policy.

blocks.en:
No single number measures repair, so we report five tiers, each answering a different question. (i) Repair: pair accuracy on the 1,500 VAL pairs, all of which the base model failed at mining.
This is a repair rate, not an estimate of accuracy, and VAL also informed our recipe decisions ( Sec. 5.4 ).
Evaluation uses a slightly different wrapper from mining (“Answer the question based only on what is visible in the image. Answer Yes or No.”), under which the base model passes 10.0% of VAL pairs; at mining, their 153 wrong cells had favored the wrong answer by a median log-odds of 0.5 (Supp. A ).
Rescored with the mining wrapper, under which the base model fails every VAL pair, VFR (seed 42) repairs 81.2% (evaluation wrapper: 82.8%).
A rephrased VAL asks the same pairs in new template wording; it was registered before any VLM was evaluated on it (Supp. F ). (ii) Blind diagnostic: the same pairs with each image replaced by a black image of the same size, passed through the normal processor.
Blind accuracy measures how much the model can answer from the question alone, and the sighted–blind gap is sighted minus blind pair accuracy.
A black image is itself an unusual input, so neither number directly measures grounding. (iii) Gold test: 747 pairs (150 per type; 147 for object existence) sampled from all generated pairs, whether or not the model fails them, on images disjoint from all training and evaluation data.
One of the authors labeled them from the image alone, blind to the generator’s labels and to every model output, without adjudication.
We dropped pairs with a “can’t tell” answer, an inconsistent answer to a repeated item, or the same answer to both questions (counts in Supp. F ), so the set is exactly half Yes .
For every arm, including all variants in Tab. 3 , we report pair accuracy and regressions (pairs the base model gets right that the trained model gets wrong), also on the 244 pairs that the question-only classifiers of Sec. 5.1 answer wrongly, whose wording points to the wrong answer. (iv) Held-out benchmarks: MME [ 12 ] , CV-Bench [ 44 ] , MMVP [ 45 ] , and the BLINK validation set [ 13 ] .
We registered them, with their scorers, exclusions, and gates, before any adapter was evaluated on them, and they informed no decision.
After decontamination they have 2,310, 1,260 + 1,200 (2D + 3D), 300, and 1,772 questions.
To test whether the spatial repair carries over to new photos, we added What’sUp’s two controlled subsets [ 24 ] , which photograph each pair of objects in four relations: on, under, left of, and right of each other in one subset, and in front of, behind, left of, and right of in the other; we specified this test after the main results and registered it before running it (Supp. F ).
We pose its photos as four-way caption choice, in all four cyclic orders of the options because the release lists the correct caption first, and in our yes/no template, asking each photo about the true relation and its opposite ( e.g . , under vs . on) and counting the photo as correct only if both answers are, with intervals over object pairs. (v) Development benchmarks: MMBench-Dev-EN v1.1 with circular evaluation [ 34 ] , NaturalBench group accuracy [ 28 ] , HallusionBench question accuracy [ 19 ] , RePOPE macro F1, yes-rate, and precision [ 38 ] , and AMBER [ 48 ] .
These informed our design and hyperparameter decisions.
We also probe NegVQA [ 52 ] and VisMin-bench [ 4 ] ; the latter is in-distribution for the VisMin-trained baselines.
TEST was used only before training, for release validation, a data audit, and a pre-registered base-model diagnostic, and to exclude its images from all later data.
After freezing the recipe, we evaluate the final arms and all variants in Tab. 3 on TEST once; no decision follows from it.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks use their native prompts, greedy decoding, and pinned harness and scorers [ 9 ] .
Strict official parsers can mark a correct full-sentence answer wrong, so for held-out benchmarks we report both the official scorer and a robust tier.
In the robust tier, a response that is exactly one option label is scored directly; any other response goes to a locked local LLM extractor, Muse Glimmer 30B [ 37 ] , which agreed with a human on 79 of 80 capability-probe responses and on 59 of 60 free-form held-out responses, half of which the official parsers could not resolve.
For each checkpoint, up to 200 randomly chosen exact-label responses also go to the extractor as canaries, and unresolved responses count as wrong.
We remove benchmark items whose images appear in any training or selection data (failure pairs, replay data, VisMin edit families, validation sets) or in other evaluations, matching by source identity, SHA-256, or perceptual hash.
blocks.zh:
基准使用其本土的提示,贪婪的解码,以及被钉住的绳索和计分器[9].
严格的官方解析器可以标记一个正确的完全判决答案是错误的,所以对于被搁置的基准,我们既报告官方计分器,也报告一个稳健的级别.
在强级中,一个完全是一个选项标签的响应直接得分;任何其他响应都到一个锁定的本地LLM提取器Muse Glimer 30B [37] ,它与一个人就80个能力探测响应中的79个和60个自由式搁置响应中的59个达成一致,其中一半的官方解析器无法解决.
对于每个检查站,多达200个随机选择的精确标签答复也作为金丝雀前往提取器,未解决的答复算错。
我们删除图像出现在任何训练或选择数据(失败对数、重播数据、VisMin编辑家庭、验证集)或其他评价中的基准项目,通过源代码SHA-256或感知散列进行匹配。

blocks.en:
The three data baselines use VFR’s base model, LoRA recipe, budget (12,000 repair units, the same 12,000 replay rows, 1,500 updates), and seeds (42–44) unless stated otherwise. Unverified applies our recipe to 12,000 mined failures (2,400 per type) drawn from the same failure pool without the committee. VisMin-native trains on VisMin’s released minimal-change data [ 4 ] , reconstructed with the authors’ builder as 6,000 two-image and 6,000 two-caption units of two choice questions each, with a uniform token loss; we omit its captioning rows. VisMin-controlled converts 12,000 VisMin edits (3,000 each of object, attribute, counting, and relation) to our single-image yes/no format (“Does the image match this description: …?”) with corrective targets and decision weighting, which isolates the data source from the format.
VisMin data is only decontaminated (41,117 of 64,392 edits remain) and converted, never filtered with our committee.
Two seed-42 controls train on the 12,000 replay rows alone ( replay only ) or replace the mined failures with 12,000 training pairs (2,400 per type) drawn at random regardless of failure (22.9% are base-model failures) and kept by the same committee ( random pairs ; Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:

VisMin 数据只经过消毒(64 392个编辑中还有41 117个),并被转换,从未与我们的委员会进行过滤。
仅在12,000列重播(仅重播)上的两列种子-42控制列车,或用任意抽取的12,000对训练双(2,400每型)代替地雷故障(22.9%为基模故障),由同一委员会保留(随机对;第3.3节)。

For internal and gold metrics we report means and ranges over seeds (five for VFR and VFR+MI, three for the VisMin arms and Unverified), and for comparisons between arms paired bootstrap intervals over image clusters (20,000 draws for the VAL contrast of VFR with Unverified, 2,000 for the others), computed on seed means; they are conditional on the trained checkpoints and not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
The multi-image replication instead uses a t t interval over five matched seeds ( Sec. 5.5 ).
Differences are computed before rounding.
For benchmark comparisons we use a paired bootstrap over image clusters (object pairs on What’sUp; 2,000 replicates) [ 10 ] , and VFR’s seed spread calibrates single-seed differences (three seeds, official tier: 0.7–1.6 points on CV-Bench, MMVP, and BLINK).

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Repair on held-out failures
blocks.zh: 5.1 修复被搁置的故障

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 compares VFR with the base model and three baselines.
VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (five seeds, 82.1–83.5%), up from 10.0%, and every type improves: spatial relation 93.0%, counting 90.0%, negation 88.9%, object existence 76.3%, and attribute 66.1% (five-seed means).
On TEST, evaluated once after the recipe was frozen, it repairs 82.9% (three seeds; base model 10.9%).
With the image replaced by a black one, VFR still answers 47.5% of VAL pairs correctly (base model: 1.9%), so training also teaches regularities of the question templates; sighted accuracy is 35.3 points higher (the sighted–blind gap; base model: 8.1).
With another VAL image instead, VFR (seed 42) answers 46.2% correctly (black image: 48.3%; on negation, 45.3% vs . 70.0%).
The gap is largest for spatial relations (64.2) and smallest for counting (13.4), where 76.6% of pairs are answered correctly without the image: only a count of one is asked in the singular, and answering Yes to singular questions and No to plural ones solves 78.7% of VAL counting pairs and 91.3% of gold ones, so this cue comes from our generator.
More broadly, logistic regressions on the question text alone, fit post hoc on TRAIN, answer 73.2% of VAL pairs correctly (negation: 93.7%) but only 67.3% of gold pairs ( Tab. 2 ), where negation falls to chance, so the negation cue is specific to the mined failures.
Repair on mined failures thus partly measures how well a model learns these cues; VFR exceeds the text-only baseline on VAL by 9.6 points.
Rephrasing the VAL questions while keeping their images and labels lowers VFR’s repair from 82.8% to 75.4% (seeds 42–44; terse targets lose only 1.8 points, Sec. 5.4 ), most on spatial relations (92.9 → \to 76.8%), so part of it is tied to our templates’ wording.
The base model, whose failures on the original wording define VAL, passes 25.1% of the rephrased pairs (57.7% of counting pairs, whose false number also changes; Supp. F ).
blocks.zh:
标签1比较了VFR与基准模型和三个基线.
VFR修复了82.8%的停产故障(5个种子,82.1-83.5%),从10.0 %上升,每类改进:空间关系93.0%,计90.0%,否定88.9%,物体存在76.3%,属性66.1%(五种子手段)。
在TEST上,在食谱被冷冻后评估过一次,它修复了82.9%(3种种子;底型10.9%).
由于图像被黑色的代替,VFR仍然正确回答47.5%的VAL对(基准模型:1.9%),因此培训也教授问题模板的规律性;视差精度高35.3分(视差-盲差;基准模型:8.1)。
反之,VFR(种子42)正确回答46.2%(黑色图像:48.3%;否定时45.3%对70.0%)。
空间关系差距最大(64.2),计数差距最小(13.4),76.6%的对子在没有图像的情况下得到正确回答:只有一个单数,回答是单数,回答是单数问题,不回答复数问题,解决78.7%的VAL计数对和91.3%,所以这个提示来自我们的生成器。
更广义地说,仅对问题文本进行后勤回归,在TRAIN上贴上专辑,正确回答73.2%的VAL配对(负数:93.7%),但只有67.3%的金配对(表2),而否定是偶然的,因此否定的提示是针对开采失败的。
因此,对埋设的故障进行修复,部分衡量一个模型如何很好地学习这些提示;VFR比VAL上仅限文本的基准多9.6点。
重写 VAL 问题,同时保留其图像和标签,将 VFR 的修复率从82.8 % 降低到75.4 % (种子42–44;terse object 仅损失 1.8 分, 第 5.4 sec ) , 大部分关于空间关系(92.9~\\=76.8 % ) , 因此部分内容与我们的模板措辞有关。
基数模型在原始措辞上的失败定义了VAL,通过25.1%的重写对数(57.7%的计数对数对数,其假数也有所改变;Supp.F.

blocks.en:
Data source. VisMin minimal-change data, trained with the same recipe and budget, repairs 27.0% in our format and 17.5% in its native choice format, most where its edits overlap our types (counting 53.8%, spatial relations 35.4%), and lowers negation, which VisMin does not cover, from 15.3% to 8.0%.
This comparison is on our failure distribution and templates, the home ground of failure-driven data, and VisMin also differs in images, wording, and coverage, so it shows only that generic minimal-change data does not repair these failures.
Random pairs test failure selection: they repair 73.4% of VAL and 74.8% of TEST (VFR, seed 42: 82.8% and 83.3%; TEST difference − 8.5 -8.5 , interval − 10.5 -10.5 to − 6.6 -6.6 ), less mainly on negation and object existence.
Few of their training negations concern spatial relations or attributes (3.2%, against 45.7% of VAL’s; only our first generation round produced these), yet most of the negation gap (38 of 54 TEST pairs) is on negated existence of present objects, which they trained on more often than VFR; there, as on object existence, VFR answers far more TEST pairs correctly without the image (63.9% vs . 7.6%; 35.3% vs . 3.3%).
blocks.zh:
数据来源. VisMin 最小变化数据,经过相同的食谱和预算培训,以我们的格式修复了27.0%,以本地选择的格式修复了17.5%,大多数情况下其编辑与我们的类型重叠(计算53.8%,空间关系35.4%),并将VisMin 不包括的否定率从15.3%降至8.0%。
这个比较是关于我们的故障分布和模板,故障驱动数据的主场,VisMin在图像,措辞和覆盖度上也有差异,因此它只显示通用的最小变化数据无法修复这些故障.
随机对试故障选择:它们修复了73.4%的VAL和74.8%的TEST(VFR,种子42:82.8%和83.3%;TEST差−8.5-8.5,间隔−10.5-10.5-−6.6-6),较少主要用于否定和物体存在.
他们的训练否定很少涉及空间关系或属性(3.2%,而VAL的45.7%;只有我们第一代就产生了这些否定差距 ) , 但大多数否定差距(54对TEST中的38对)在于否定现有物体的存在,他们比VFR更经常地接受过这种训练;关于物体的存在,VFR回答正确得多的TEST对没有图像(63.9%对7.6%;35.3%对3.3%)。

blocks.en:
Retention. On development benchmarks, VFR gains 6.5 points on MMBench with its official parser and 2.9 on NaturalBench, and changes HallusionBench and RePOPE F1 by − 1.3 -1.3 and − 0.2 -0.2 (seed 42).
MMBench rises about 6 points for every trained arm except VisMin-native (+0.2), but its official parser fails on 7.4% of the base model’s responses (VFR: 1.2%); on the 1,132 groups it parses for both, each answers 1,000 correctly.
With the robust tier’s extractor ( Sec. 4 ), the base model scores 85.6% and VFR 85.3% (difference − 0.3 -0.3 , interval − 1.4 -1.4 to + 0.8 +0.8 ; over seeds 42–44: 85.2%, − 0.4 -0.4 , − 1.4 -1.4 to + 0.7 +0.7 ), so VFR’s official gain comes from the parser.
The same holds for replay alone (robust: 85.4%; difference − 0.2 -0.2 , interval − 1.2 -1.2 to + 0.8 +0.8 ), training without replay (85.0%; − 0.6 -0.6 , − 2.0 -2.0 to + 0.8 +0.8 ), and VisMin-native over seeds 42–44 (85.2%; − 0.4 -0.4 , − 1.5 -1.5 to + 0.6 +0.6 , against an official gain of 3.0 points); the other arms were scored with the official parser only.
Without replay ( Tab. 3 ), VFR loses 13.8 points on NaturalBench, 8.4 on HallusionBench, and 14.6 in RePOPE F1, so replay largely prevents these losses; replay alone repairs 9.9% of VAL (base model: 10.0%).
On the held-out benchmarks too, training without replay loses 15.3 points on MMVP and 3.7 on BLINK relative to VFR (robust tier, seed 42; intervals − 22.5 -22.5 to − 8.0 -8.0 and − 5.5 -5.5 to − 2.0 -2.0 ), while it gains 1.9 on CV-Bench 2D (an interval above zero).
Because the development benchmarks informed our decisions ( Sec. 5.4 ), the held-out benchmarks carry the retention claim.
There (robust tier, seed 42), VFR gains 2.9 points on CV-Bench 2D (95% interval 1.1–4.8), shows no clear change on CV-Bench 3D, MME, and MMVP, and loses 3.3 on BLINK (1.4–5.1), most on its two-image tasks ( Sec. 5.5 ).
Both changes hold over seeds 42–44 (CV-Bench 2D: +2.9, interval 1.2–4.6; BLINK: − 2.8 -2.8 , − 4.6 -4.6 to − 1.2 -1.2 ), and in each seed CV-Bench 3D, MME, and MMVP show no clear change.
Official parsers, which fail on more of the base model’s long answers (BLINK: 12.7% unresolved; VFR: none), would favor VFR on both (CV-Bench 2D: +6.8; BLINK: +0.7).
Unverified and the two VisMin baselines move CV-Bench 2D and BLINK the same way (seed 42): by +1.7 to +2.2 and − 2.0 -2.0 to − 5.2 -5.2 points ( Tab. 1 ; intervals exclude zero except VisMin-native’s 2D gain).
Over seeds 42–44, VFR+MI, Unverified, VisMin-controlled, and VisMin-native move them the same way (CV-Bench 2D: +3.0, +2.5, +2.3, and +2.0; BLINK: − 2.2 -2.2 , − 1.9 -1.9 , − 2.0 -2.0 , and − 4.2 -4.2 ; every interval excludes zero), with no clear change on CV-Bench 3D, MME, or MMVP.
Random pairs and replay alone do too (CV-Bench 2D: +2.5 and +1.8; BLINK: − 2.6 -2.6 and − 1.5 -1.5 ; intervals exclude zero except replay alone’s BLINK loss, − 3.0 -3.0 to + 0.2 +0.2 ).
Split post hoc, CV-Bench 2D’s counting questions rise for every arm in Tab. 1 , replay alone included (by 2.2–3.6 points), and its relation questions by at most 2.1 (VFR), so its gain is not a spatial gain by itself.
blocks.zh:
续住持. 在发展基准方面,VFR在MMBench上获得了6.5分,在Natural Bench上获得了2.9分,并将Hallusion Bench和RePOPE F1改为−1.3-1.3和−0.2-0.2(种子42)。
MMBench除了VisMin-native(+0.2)之外,每条训练有素的手臂都上升了约6分,但其官方解析器在基本模型7.4%的回复(VFR:1.2%)上失败;在1,132个组合中,每个组合都正确回答1000个。

blocks.en: 5.2 Repair on unconditioned pairs
blocks.zh: 5.2 修复无条件配对

blocks.en:
On the gold pairs, sampled regardless of failure and labeled without our committee ( Tab. 2 ), VFR raises pair accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% (five seeds, 91.8–92.8%; difference 5.0 points, 95% interval over images 2.5–7.5), fixing 73.8% of the base model’s errors and breaking 4.9% of its correct pairs, whereas replay alone and both VisMin arms do not improve it (84.5–86.9%).
Random pairs do about as well (92.0%, seed 42; − 0.8 -0.8 points from VFR’s seed 42, interval − 2.5 -2.5 to + 0.8 +0.8 ): on gold, selecting failures adds little.
The gain comes from spatial relations (66.7 → \to 96.8%), which improve this much only in arms trained on our generator’s pairs, mined or not (random pairs: 96.0%), and it holds where the wording points to the wrong answer (70.8 → \to 97.5%; interval for the gain 14.6–39.6), so this repair uses the image.
The gain is largest on above/below, the base model’s weak axis: its pair accuracy is 91.8% on left/right but 42.9% on above/below, which VFR raises to 95.6% (left/right: 98.1%); likewise, two-thirds of the held-out spatial failures are above/below, and VFR repairs 97.6% of those against 83.8% of the left/right ones.
Gold keeps only pairs that a person answers, with different answers to the two questions, so for spatial relations it keeps 150 of the 372 sampled pairs the author labeled: 153 had a question the author could not answer from the image, 68 got the same answer to both questions, and one exceeded the quota (Supp. F ).
On the other four types together, VFR gains where the wording points to the right answer and loses where it points to the wrong one, ending 1.3 points below the base model.
Negation falls for every trained arm; for VFR it falls by 8.9 points (interval 2.6–15.0), entirely on negations about absent objects (88.0 → \to 65.9%; replay only: 78.7%), which are 6.1% of the training negations and half of gold’s, while negations about present objects improve (89.3 → \to 93.6%).
Splitting the labeled answer’s log-odds into a blind part and the image’s contribution suggests why: on absent-object negations the blind part falls by 10.3 and the image’s contribution rises by only 3.9, so from the wording of negated questions VFR learned the answer that fits present objects (Supp. G ).
Random pairs, 23.4% of whose training negations ask about the existence of an absent object (VFR: 1.9%), keep that kind at the base model’s 96.0% (VFR, seed 42: 72.0%), but fall from 72.0% to 16.0% on spatial-relation negations about absent objects, which they almost never trained on (8 of 2,400).
Over all 244 pairs whose wording points to the wrong answer, VFR is therefore no better than the base model ( − 2.5 -2.5 points, interval − 7.6 -7.6 to + 2.9 +2.9 ; Tab. 1 , Conf. ).
Repair on held-out failures hides this: there, VFR repairs 88.9% of negation failures.
These results hold on the 735 gold pairs whose author labels match the stored ones (VFR: 93.7%, base model: 88.2%; spatial relations: 97.4% vs . 67.1%; Supp. G ).
blocks.zh:
在黄金配对上,无论试样失败与否,没有我们的委员会贴标签(图2),VFR将配对精度从87.4%提高到92.4%(5个种子,91.8-92.8 %;差5.0点,与图像2.5-7.5的间隔为95%),固定了基型误差的73.8%,打破了正确配对的4.9%,而单反播放和Vismin双臂都没有改善(84.5-86.9%)。
随机对子也做大约(92.0%,种子42;−从VFR的种子42的0.8-0.8点,间隔−2.5-2.5到+0.8+0.8):在黄金上,选择失败增加不多.
其收益来自空间关系(66.7~~~~96.8 %),它只通过对发电机的对子(无论是否被开采)进行武器训练来改善这一点(随机对子:96.0%),它所持的措辞指向错误的答案(70.8~~~~97.5%;对收益的间隔14.6~39.6),因此这一修复使用了图像。
在上/下,基底模型的弱轴上收益最大:其双对精度在左/右为91.8%,而在上/下为42.9%,VFR上升至95.6%(左/右:98.1%);同样,被搁置的空间故障有三分之二在上/下,VFR修复的为97.6%,而左/右的为83.8%。
Gold只保留一个人回答的对子,对两个问题有不同的答案,因此对于空间关系,它保留了作者标注的372个抽样对子中的150个:153个有作者无法从图像中回答的问题,68个得到两个问题的相同答案,一个超过配额(Supp.F.).
在其他四种类型中,VFR在措辞指向正确答案,而在措辞指向错误答案时丢失,在基准模型下方结束1.3分.
每一只训练有素的手臂都被忽略;而VFR则下降了8.9分(中间点2.6–15.0),完全是因为对缺失物体的否定(88.0–======================================================================================================================================================================================================================
将标注的答案的对数分成一个盲点,而图像的贡献说明为什么:在不标点否定时,盲点部分下降了10.3,图像的贡献只上升了3.9,因此从否定问题的措辞中,VFR学到了适合当前对象的答案(Supp.G )。
随机对等,其中23.4%的训练否定者询问是否存在缺失物体(VFR:1.9%),将此类物体保留在基准模型的96.0%(VFR,种子42:72.0%),但在空间关系否定缺失物体方面却从72.0%下降到16.0%,几乎从未对此类物体进行过训练(2,400分之8 ) 。
因此,在措辞指错答案的所有244对中,VFR并不比基准模型更好(−2.5-2.5分,间隔−7.6-7.6至+2.9+2.9;Tab. 1,Conf. )。
修复被搁置的故障掩盖了这一点:在那里,VFR修复88.9%的否定故障.
这些结果涉及735对金子,其作者标签与所储存的金子相符(VFR:93.7%,基准模型:88.2%;空间关系:97.4%对67.1%;Supp.G)。

blocks.en:
Beyond our generator. The gold test shares our generator’s templates and annotation sources, so it cannot show whether the spatial repair carries over to new photos.
Rewriting its spatial questions shows that most of the gain over the base model survives new wording, although VFR’s own accuracy falls when its questions are paraphrased: it scores 87.3% instead of 96.8% (interval for the change − 14.0 -14.0 to − 5.3 -5.3 ), still well above the base model’s 62.0%, losing mostly on above/below, while converse questions, which swap the two objects, cost it 2.3 points, an interval including zero (Supp. F ).
On What’sUp’s controlled photos, which the base model nearly solves (95.6% in our yes/no format), VFR falls to 89.4% (five seeds; difference − 6.2 -6.2 points, interval − 8.2 -8.2 to − 4.2 -4.2 ).
The loss comes from the 103 photos of an object under another, the only relation that declines: VFR answers both questions correctly for 26.4% of them (base model: 84.5%; change − 58.1 -58.1 points, interval − 67.3 -67.3 to − 48.9 -48.9 ), against 91.1% of the matching photos with the object on top (base model: 86.4%; for this and the other relations, the interval for the change includes zero).
Every arm trained on our pairs loses on the “under” photos (Unverified: 2.3%; random pairs: 45.6%), while replay alone and VisMin-native do not (88.3% and 87.7%; Supp. G ).
The error is one-sided (post hoc): on these photos VFR affirms the true “under” question (99.8%) but also the false “on” question (70.3%; base model: 11.7%); on “on” photos it affirms the false “under” question for only 8.7%.
It does not need our directional relation pairs: a post hoc seed-42 run trained without them affirms the false “on” at least as often (79.6%) and the false “under” too (86.4% of “on” photos), while the arms trained with them usually reject the false “under” but not the false “on”.
Asked with “below” and “above”, the words of our relation pairs, VFR answers the “under” photos correctly (99.6%; base model: 96.1%) but affirms “above” for only 46.0% of the “on” photos (base model: 99.0%; Supp. G ).
With caption choice, What’sUp’s own format, this loss does not appear: the base model scores 97.6%, and VFR stays at that level (97.7%; interval for the change − 0.3 -0.3 to + 0.4 +0.4 ) and picks the right caption for every “under” photo, as the base model does; by relation, its only clear changes are a gain on “behind” (91.4% to 94.7%; interval + 1.6 +1.6 to + 5.1 +5.1 ) and a small decline on left/right (99.0% vs . 99.5%; interval − 0.9 -0.9 to − 0.2 -0.2 ).
The other arms evaluated on caption choice also stay at 97.6–97.9% (three seeds for Unverified and the VisMin arms, seed 42 for the others), and each of them that was trained on our pairs still picks the right caption for nearly every “under” photo (at least 99.5% of option orders) although its yes/no answers about them fail on most (Supp. G ).
The model thus still tells “under” apart when it chooses among captions; what training breaks is how it answers our yes/no questions about these photos, in ways that depend on the relation word.
blocks.zh:
在发电机外 金测试分享了我们发电机的模板和注释来源,因此无法显示空间修复是否延续到新照片上。
重写其空间问题表明,对基模型的大部分收益在新措辞中幸存下来,尽管VFR本身的准确度在它的问题被解释时下降:它得分87.3%而不是96.8%(变化的间隔为 - 14.0 -14.0 到 - 5.3 - 5.3),仍然远远高于基模型的62.0%,大部分损失在上方/下方,而对调问题则将两个对象互换,代价为2.3分,间隔包括零(Supp.F)。
在“What's Up”的控制照片上,基本模型几乎解决了(95.6%的“是/否”格式),VFR下降到89.4%(5种种子;差值−6.2-6.2分,间隔−8.2-8.2至4.2-4.2)。
损失来自另一个物体下的103张照片,唯一下降的关联:VFR正确回答了其中26.4%的两个问题(基准模型:84.5%;变化−58.1-58.1分,间隔−67.3-67.3至−48.9-48.9),而顶部匹配物体的照片的91.1%(基准模型:86.4%;对于这个和其他关系,变化的间隔包括零).
每一只在双人身上受过训练的手臂都会在“下”照片上丢失(未经证实:2.3%;随机对数:45.6%),而仅重播和Vismin-native则不会(88.3%和87.7%;Supp.G)。
错误是片面的(事后临时):在这些照片上,VFR肯定了真正的“under”问题(99.8%),但也肯定了虚假的“on”问题(70.3%;基准模型:11.7%);在“on”照片上,它确认虚假的“under”问题仅占8.7%。
它不需要我们的方向关系对:在未经过特殊训练的42号种子后运行时,至少经常(79.6%)确认假“上”和假“下”两种情况(86.4%的“上”照片),而用它们训练的武器通常拒绝假“下”而不是假“上”。
VFR用“以下”和“以上”两个字来回答“以下”照片的正确性(99.6%;基准模型:96.1%),但只确认46.0%的“以上”(基准模型:99.0%;Supp.G)。
有字幕选择, 其基本模式为97.6%, VFR则保持在这一水平(97.7%;更改的间隔为0.3-0.3至+0.4+0.4),并按基本模式的做法为每张 " under " 照片选择正确的标题;根据关系,它唯一的明显变化是 " shind " (91.4%至94.7%;间隔+1.6+1.6至+5.1+5.1)和左/右小幅下降(99.0%对99.5%;间隔为0.9-0.9至0.2-0.2)。
在标题选择上评价的其他武器也保持在97.6-97.9%(未验证的三颗种子和维斯明臂,其他的42个种子),而且每个接受过双人训练的武器仍然为几乎每张 " 低于 " 的图片(至少99.5%的选项订单)选择正确的标题,尽管大部分的答案是/没有(Supp.G)。
因此,模型在选择标题时仍会分辨“下面”;培训中断之处在于它如何以取决于关系词的方式回答我们对这些照片的肯定/否定的问题。

blocks.en: 5.3 Why verification matters
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 核查为何重要

blocks.en:
Mined failures carry more label problems than unconditioned pairs: on the sampled gold candidates whose two questions the author answered, the author’s answers and the stored labels disagree on 16.6% of pairs (153 of 920), against 37 wrong labels in the 100 audited mined failures ( Sec. 3.3 ).
Removing the committee changes only which mined pairs are trained on.
The unverified arm repairs 76.0% (three seeds), 6.8 points below VFR (seed 42 vs . seed 42: 6.9 points, 95% interval over images 4.8–8.9; VFR’s seed range: 1.3).
VAL contains only committee-approved failures, so this comparison favors the distribution VFR was trained on; on the gold test, labeled without the committee, the gap widens: the unverified arm falls below the base model (80.8% vs . 87.4%; difference − 6.6 -6.6 points, interval − 10.1 -10.1 to − 3.2 -3.2 ) and 11.6 points below VFR (9.3–14.0), breaking 17.6% of the pairs the base model gets right.
Most of the loss comes from negation (68.9% vs . 88.9%), and the blind diagnostic shows why.
On negated questions, the image does not help the unverified model: its sighted–blind gap averages − 6.0 -6.0 points (seeds − 6.0 -6.0 , − 13.3 -13.3 , and + 1.3 +1.3 ), whereas VFR’s is + 25.2 +25.2 (five seeds).
It has learned to answer negated templates from their text: on gold negations about absent objects it is right 4.0% of the time, like the text-only classifiers (6.7%; base model: 88.0%; Tab. 2 ).
None of the development benchmarks we report sees the shortcut (Unverified is within 0.7 points of VFR on each; Tab. 1 ); among our evaluations only the blind diagnostic and the gold test expose it.
blocks.zh:
矿井故障的标签问题比没有条件的对子要多:在被抽样的黄金候选人中,作者回答的两个问题,作者的答案和储存的标签在16.6%的对子(920年153个)上存在分歧,而在100个经审计的开采故障中,37个标签错误(第3.3节)。
清除委员会只改变所培训的地雷对。
未验证臂修理 76.0%(3个种子),VFR以下6.8分(种子42对种子42:6.9分,相距95%于图像). 4.8-8.9; VFR的种子范围:1.3.
VAL只包含经委员会批准的失败,因此这一比较有利于VFR的分发;在没有委员会标记的黄金测试上,缺口扩大:未验证的手臂落在基模以下(80.8%对87.4%;差值−6.6-6.6分,间隔−10.1-10.1至−3.2-3.2)和VFR以下(9.3-14.0)11.6分,打破基模对数的17.6%.
大部分损失来自否定(68.9%对88.9%),盲目诊断表明原因。
在否定的问题上,图像对未经验证的模型没有帮助:其视差-盲差平均值−6.0-6.0点(种子−6.0-6.0,−13.3-13.3,和+1.3+1.3),而VFR的为+25.2+25.2(5种种子).
它学会了从文本中回答否定的模板:在关于缺失对象的黄金否定时,它恰好是4.0%的时间,就像文本唯一的分类器(6.7%;基准模型:88.0%;Tab. 2).
我们报告的发展基准中没有任何一个看到捷径(未经核实的捷径在每处0.7分以内;附件1);在我们的评价中,只有盲目诊断和黄金测试暴露出来。

blocks.en:
Tab. 3 changes one component at a time (seed 42); Supp. Fig. 2 plots it with a learning-rate sweep.
At fixed replay, terse Yes / No targets give the highest repair (84.0%) but make the model answer Yes more often on RePOPE (44.1 → \to 51.7%), lowering precision from 92.4 to 81.3; our own registered decision rule, which used repair, chose them.
Corrective targets keep the prior but repair 3.5 points less; at the mean target length the Yes / No token gets only 9.2% of a corrective target’s loss weight, and doubling that weight ( w = 2 w{=}2 ) recovers 2.3 points while RePOPE’s yes-rate rises by only 1.6.
Heavier weighting, less replay, and higher learning rates raise the yes-rate or blind accuracy at about the same repair (Supp. Fig. 2 ).
We chose w = 2 w{=}2 and 12k replay rows by judgment (our registered rules preferred w = 4 w{=}4 and 24k rows), so VFR is not the winner of any single registered rule.
Gold accuracy varies little across these recipes (91.3–93.7%, terse targets highest; VFR’s five seeds: 91.8–92.8%); they differ more in the answer prior and blind accuracy, which repair accuracy does not reveal (TEST repair: 81.1–85.9%, in nearly the same order as on VAL).
On the rephrased VAL, terse targets lose only 1.8 points and w = 8 w{=}8 3.5, although both also lower RePOPE precision; every other variant or arm we tested on it that trains on our pairs (seed 42) loses 5.3–9.1, within the range of VFR’s three seeds (5.1–9.7; Supp. E ).

blocks.en: 5.5 A side effect on two-image questions
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 二象题的副作用

blocks.en:
Training also changes how the model handles a task it was not trained on.
VisMin’s relation subset [ 4 ] shows two images that differ in one spatial relation and asks which image matches a caption, once for each of two opposite captions (622 groups).
The base model describes both images before answering (median 131 tokens) and gets both captions right in 74.3% of groups.
After training, VFR answers with a bare “First” or “Second” (median 2 tokens), and paired accuracy falls to 49.6% (five-seed mean; every seed 20.9–27.2 points below the base model).
blocks.zh:
培训还改变了模式如何处理未培训的任务。
VisMin 关系子集 [4] 显示两个不同空间关系的图像, 并询问哪个图像匹配一个标题,
基础模型在回答前描述两个图像(中间131个令牌),并在74.3%的组中获得两个标题正确.
训练后,VFR用赤裸的 " 第一 " 或 " 第二 " (中间2个令牌)回答,配对精度降至49.6%(五种子平均值;每种子低于基准模型20.9至27.2分)。

blocks.en:
Among groups in which the model picks different images for the two captions, it is right 96–97% of the time before and after training ( Tab. 4 , Cond. ); what falls is caption sensitivity: the trained model picks the same image for both captions in about half of the groups, including 206 of the 209 groups that the base model gets right and VFR (seed 42) gets wrong (by relation axis: Supp. I ).
Asking the trained model to describe each image first recovers 15.4 points net of new errors for seed 42 (five seeds: 6.1–15.4, mean 10.7), regaining 123 of those 209 groups, whereas the same prompt slightly lowers the base model’s paired accuracy (74.3% to 72.5%): describing first is not simply a better prompt; it undoes part of what training broke.
Held-out BLINK points the same way: on its four two-image tasks VFR is 10.8 points below the base model on average (replay alone: 7.3), against 0.4 above on single-image tasks and 1.4 below on tasks with three or four images (no registered intervals at this level).
The unverified arm drops in the same way, as do random pairs (46.5%) and replay alone (48.4%, median 2 tokens), so the repair data are not needed for the drop.
blocks.zh:
在模型为两个标题选择不同图像的组别中,培训前后时间的96-97%是正确的(Tab 4, Cond. ); 掉落的是标题敏感性:经过培训的模型在大约一半的组别中为两个标题选择相同的图像,包括基础模型获得正确和VFR(种子42)的206个组别(按关系轴:Supp. I).
要求训练有素的模型描述每一幅图像,首先会弥补42号种子(5个种子:6.1-15.4,即10.7)新错误的15.4点,重新获得这209个种子组中的123个,而同样的瞬间会略微降低基模型的配对精度(74.3 % 至72.5% ): 描述第一不仅仅是一个更好的瞬间;它消除了训练失败的部分内容。
Hold-out BLINK的指向相同:在其四个双图像任务上,VFR平均比基准模型低10.8分(仅重播:7.3),而上方为单图像任务0.4分,下方为三四图像任务1.4分(此级别没有注册间隔).
未验证的手臂以同样的方式下降,随机对数(46.5%),单独重播(48.4%,中位数2个令牌),因此不需修复数据进行掉落.

blocks.en:
Multi-image replay. We replaced 1,500 single-image description rows of the replay data with 750 two-image caption-selection groups built from unedited COCO training photos, with the base model’s own responses as targets, kept only when it chose correctly for both captions.
In the pre-registered seed-42 run, this recovered paired accuracy fully (76.0%, vs . 74.3% for the base model), at a repair cost of 0.5 points.
The replication was weaker: over five matched seeds, multi-image replay gains 28.9, 9.8, 8.5, 12.1, and 2.6 points over VFR, a mean of 12.4 (95% t t -interval over seeds: 0.1 to 24.7), all positive but only seeds 42 and 45 above the registered 10-point criterion.
This recovers about half of VFR’s average loss at essentially no repair cost (82.8% on VAL with and without it, five-seed means).
Recovery tracks whether the model resumes describing before choosing: seed 42 answers with a median of 126 tokens and recovers fully, while seeds 43–46 stay terse (2–3 tokens) and recover partly, mainly through higher caption sensitivity.
The other costs are small: 0.4 points on gold on average (seed 42: 2.8, concentrated on negation).
blocks.zh:
多画面重播. 我们用750个由未经编辑的COCO训练照片组成的双像字幕选集组取代了1500个重播数据的单像描述行,而基数模型自己的回应作为目标,只有当它正确选择两种标题时才保留。
在预先注册的种子-42运行中,这种恢复的配对精度完全(基模为76.0%对74.3%),修复成本为0.5分.
复制能力较弱:超过5个匹配的种子,多象重播增益28.9,9.8,8.5,12.1和比VFR高2.6分,平均值为12.4(95% t-在种子上间距:0.1至24.7),所有正种子42和45均高于注册的10分标准.
这以基本上没有修理成本的方式收回了VFR平均损失的一半左右(无论有没有VAL,82.8%是五种子手段)。
恢复跟踪模型是否在选择之前恢复描述:种子42回答的中位数为126个令牌并完全恢复,而种子43-46停留特尔斯(2-3个令牌)并部分恢复,主要通过更高的字幕敏感性.
其他成本较小:平均黄金0.4分(种子42:2.8,集中于否定).

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
We repair one model; mining is model-specific, and a second backbone is future work.
Questions come from templates: much of VAL and two-thirds of gold are predictable from the question text alone ( Sec. 5.1 ), failures on free-form questions are not tested, and the gold test shares the generator; its rewritten spatial questions change only the wording and the order of the objects.
The committee is a filter, not ground truth: on the audited failures it discards a third of the model errors ( Sec. 3.3 ), and 5.0% of verified target cells were factually wrong, including 5 of 40 counting cells, whose labels come from captions.
All human labels, including both audits and the gold test, come from one of the authors, without a second annotator or adjudication; on the 200 questions shown twice during gold labeling, the two answers agreed 194 times.
VAL and TEST contain only committee-approved failures, VAL and the development benchmarks informed our decisions, the What’sUp and rewritten-gold tests were specified after the main results, and most ablations, including the random-pairs control, have one seed.
The VisMin baselines are our reconstruction on our model and recipe.
The multi-image fix is partial and varies across seeds, and outside VisMin the side effect shows only in BLINK’s subtasks.
Finally, the blind diagnostic uses an unusual input, a black image, and the LLM extractor was validated on samples; unresolved answers count as wrong.
blocks.zh:
我们修复一个模型;采矿是特定模型,第二个支柱是未来工作。
问题来自模板:VAL的大部分和三分之二的黄金仅从问题文本(第5.1节)就可预见,自由形式问题的失败没有经过测试,黄金测试共享生成器;其重写空间问题只改变对象的措辞和顺序.
委员会是一个过滤器,而不是地面真理:在审计的失败中,它抛弃了三分之一的模型错误(第3.3节),5.0%经核实的目标细胞事实上是错误的,包括40个计数单元格中的5个,其标签来自标题.
所有的人的标签,包括审计和金质测试,都来自一位作者,没有第二个注释者或裁决;在金质标签制作期间两次显示的200个问题上,两个答案同意194次.
VAL和TEST只包含委员会批准的失败,VAL和发展基准为我们的决定提供了依据,What's Up和重写金本位测试是在主要结果之后指定的,而大多数的崩盘,包括随机针盘控制,都有一个种子.
维斯明的基线是我们在模式和食谱上的重建。
多图像固定是局部的,并且因种子而异,在VisMin之外,副效果只在BLINK的子任务中显示.
最后,盲诊断使用不寻常的输入,黑色的图像,LLM提取器在样本上被验证;未解的答案算作错误.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Training a VLM on its own mined failures can repair real errors, here spatial relations (66.7% to 96.8% on independently labeled pairs), even where the question’s wording points to the wrong answer, but repair accuracy on held-out failures overstates what it repairs.
Four lessons apply beyond our setting.
First, verify mined failures: they carry more label problems than unconditioned pairs ( Sec. 5.3 ), and training on them taught a negation shortcut that pushed accuracy on unconditioned pairs below the base model, unseen by our development benchmarks.
Second, measure repair on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs, separated by whether the question’s wording alone gives the answer, because held-out failures share the wording cues of the training failures and rarely contain what training breaks; selecting failures added 8.5 points of TEST repair but 0.8 on gold.
Third, test tasks the training did not target: two-image relation accuracy fell by 24.6 points (five-seed mean), and BLINK’s two-image tasks by 10.8 (seed 42), regressions that no single-image benchmark can show.
Fourth, test a repair beyond the generator that produced it: rewording the questions cost 16.1 points of spatial repair on held-out failures and 9.5 points of accuracy on gold spatial pairs, where VFR stayed well above the base model (87.3% vs . 62.0%), and on new photos the model’s answers to our yes/no questions about objects under others collapsed while its caption choices for the same photos stayed perfect.
blocks.zh:
对自身开采故障进行VLM培训可以修复真正的错误,这里的空间关系(66.7%到96.8%在独立标记的对子上),即使问题的措辞指向了错误的答案,但对于被搁置故障的修复精确度却高估了修复内容。
四个教训超越了我们的范畴。
首先,核查地雷的故障:地雷的标签问题比不附带条件的对数要多(第5.3节),关于地雷的培训教授了一种否定的捷径,将无附带条件的对数的准确性推到基数模型以下,这是我们的发展基准所看不到的。
第二,在独立标记的、无条件的对子上进行测量修复,从问题措辞本身是否给出答案来区分开来,因为被搁置的失败与培训失败的措辞提示相同,很少包含培训中断;选择失败增加了8.5分的TEST修复,而黄金则增加了0.8分。
第三,测试任务 训练没有目标:双像关系精度下降24.6分(5种子平均值),BLINK的双像任务下降10.8分(种子42),回归,没有单一图像基准能够显示.
第四,测试一个超出产生它的发电机的修补:重写问题需要16.1个空间修复点,黄金空间对9.5个精确点,其中VFR远远高于基准模型(87.3%对62.0%),在新照片上,该模型对我们对他人下面物体的回答是/否的回答崩溃了,而它对相同照片的字幕选择仍然完美。

blocks.en:
Why the base model passes 10% of VAL. Every VAL pair failed at mining, yet under the evaluation wrapper the base model passes 150 of the 1,500 (spatial relations: 23 of 300).
At mining, the 153 cells that later flipped had favored the wrong answer by a median log-probability difference of 0.5, and a tenth of them by 1.75 or more, so they were not all near-ties; the change of wrapper is the likeliest cause, but no controlled comparison isolates it.
Rescored with the mining wrapper, under which the base model fails every VAL pair, VFR (seed 42) repairs 81.2% (evaluation wrapper: 82.8%).

Human audits. In the audit of 100 mined failures before verification, wrong labels were most frequent for attributes (10 of 20) and object existence (9), then spatial relations (8), counting, and negation (5 each).

blocks.en:
The controls’ training pairs. Of the 12,000 pairs Unverified trains on, 3,202 had also gone to the committee in round two: 1,996 of these (62.3%) were label disagreements, 900 were kept, 304 were ambiguous, and 2 went to review.
The other 8,798 were never judged, so we do not extrapolate a rate.
For random pairs, the committee judged 20,695 pairs drawn regardless of failure and kept 72.5%, from 49.7% of the spatial pairs to 87.0% of the counting pairs.
blocks.zh:
管制人员的培训对联。 在乘坐的12,000对未经验证的列车中,有3,202对也在第二轮中进入了委员会:其中1,996对(62.3%)是标签分歧,900对保留,304对模棱两可,2对前往审查.
其他8,798人从未被判定,所以我们不推断一个比率。
对于随机配对,委员会判断无论失败与否抽取的20,695对,保留了72.5%,从空间配对的49.7%到计数配对的87.0%.

blocks.en: C Corrective targets and human audit
blocks.zh: C. 纠正目标和人的审计

blocks.en:
Templates. Each type has two template families with four surface variants each (negation: four families of four variants plus three variants for overlap, 19 in all), filled from the pair’s stored slots, such as the object, the true and the asked color or number, or the relation ( Tab. 9 ).
Every target begins with Yes or No as a single token, the token that first-token scoring compares, so a corrective target trains the scored decision directly and states the fact after it.
blocks.zh:
标本. 每个类型有两个模板家族,各有四个表型变体(负数:四个家族四个变体加三个变体重叠,共19个),由对子存储的槽填充,如对象,真和被请求的颜色或数字,或关系(Tab.9).
每个目标都以是或 没有作为单一的代号,第一名得分比较的代号,所以一个矫正目标直接训练得分决定,并在决定后说明事实.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Corrective targets. Targets of the pairs in Tab. 5 , with the number of templates per type and the mean target length in TRAIN (tokens, without the end-of-turn token).
blocks.zh: 表9:纠正目标。 塔布两对的目标. 5,包含每类模板的数量和TRAIN中的平均目标长度(纸箱,没有转折的符号).

blocks.en:
Decision weight. In a target of length L L , the decision token’s share of the cell’s loss weights is w / ( w + L − 1 ) w/(w+L-1) ( Eq. 1 ); at the mean length of 10.87 tokens it is 9.2%, 16.9%, 28.8%, 37.8%, and 44.8% for w = 1 w=1 , 2, 4, 6, and 8 ( Tab. 3 ).
Replay rows are never weighted this way.

重播行从不这样加权.

blocks.en:
Audit of the rendered targets. The author checked 100 TRAIN pairs (20 per type, 200 target cells; seed 20261020) against their images.
A cell’s target counts as correct if its decision and fact are right and its wording is acceptable: 176 of the 200 were (81 of 100 pairs).
10 stated a wrong fact or decision, 5 of them in counting, whose true numbers come from captions; spatial relations had 3, object existence 2, and attributes and negation none.
The remaining verdicts were 12 uncertain and 2 ambiguous questions.
blocks.zh:
对既定目标的审计。 作者对照他们的图像检查了100对TRAIN配对(每型20对,目标细胞200对;种子20261020).
如果一个单元格的决定和事实正确,而且其措辞可以接受,则其目标是正确的:200人中有176人(100对中的81人)。
10个国家说出一个错误的事实或决定,其中5个国家在计算,其真实数字来自标题;空间关系有3个对象存在2,没有属性和否定。
其余判决有12个不确定和两个模棱两可的问题。

blocks.en: D Replay data
blocks.zh: D 重播数据

blocks.en:
Tab. 10 lists the replay rows by category and target source.
They are the first 12,000 of a seeded ranking of a 60,000-row replay release, so the larger and smaller replay sets of Tab. 3 are nested.
Descriptions, open-ended VQA, and text-only instructions take the frozen base model’s own greedy response as target (bf16, seed 42, batches of 4; at most 128 new tokens for open-ended VQA and 256 for the others); replay keeps each source’s own instruction, without a repair wrapper.
Replay images exclude every image of the frozen splits, and held-out benchmark items whose images occur in the replay data are left out of the clean populations (Supp. F ).
blocks.zh:
Tab. 10按类别和目标源列出重播行.
他们是60,000-row重播发行的种子排行榜的前12,000名,因此Tab的大小重播集. 三为巢.
描述,无限制的VQA,和文本专用的指令将冷冻的基模自身贪婪的反应作为目标(bf16,种子42,批次4;最多128个新的无限制VQA的代号,其他的256个);重播时保留每个源自己的指令,没有修理的包装.
重放图像排除了每张被冻结的拆分图像,在重放数据中出现图像的被搁置的基准项目被忽略在干净的人群之外(Supp.F.).

blocks.zh: 表10:重播数据。 1.2万行按类别重播,其目标来源;8,020个目标来自基模.

blocks.en: E Training details and recipe sweeps
blocks.zh: E 培训细节和食谱扫描

blocks.en:
Training settings. Tab. 11 lists the training settings of VFR.
In an earlier registered experiment we also supervised the end-of-turn token, and we kept it unsupervised; over its two seeds, VAL pair accuracy without that supervision had a sample standard deviation of 1.04 points.
A later learning-rate and batch-size sweep (seed 42) found nothing to adopt: the best setting within our tolerances, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} at the same batch size, gained 0.39 points on the registered development objective, below the registered threshold of 0.82 points (the mean range of VFR’s three seeds on the four development metrics), so the reference recipe stayed.
blocks.zh:
培训环境。 标签11列出了VFR的训练设置.
在早先的一次注册实验中,我们还监督了转折的标志,我们保持了它不受监督;在它的两种种子上,没有监督的VAL配对精度有1.04分的样本标准差.
后来的一次学习速率和批量大小的扫荡(种子42)没有发现什么可采纳的:在我们的耐受度范围内的最佳设置,学习速率10 - 4 10 QQ-4}相同批量大小,在注册的发展目标上获得了0.39分,低于注册的0.82分的阈值(VFR在四个开发指标上的3个种子的平均范围),因此参考食谱保持不变.

blocks.zh: 表11:培训环境。 VFR的设置;基线仅改变其数据.

Terse targets, which supervise only the answer token of each repair target, lose only 1.8 points (spatial relations: 2.3) and w = 8 w{=}8 3.5 (6.3), although both also lower RePOPE precision (to 81.3 and 88.0; base model: 92.4); every other variant or arm in Tab. 12 trained on our pairs (seed 42) loses 5.3–9.1 points (spatial relations: 12.0–21.7), about as much as VFR’s three seeds (5.1–9.7; spatial relations: 11.0–20.0), while the arms that do not learn our pairs gain overall, like the base model.

由食谱重写 VAL. 食谱被冻结后评价的重新措辞的VAL(Supp.F)显示,每种食谱的修复多少取决于模板的措辞(表12)。
Terse目标只监督每个修理目标的回答符号,只损失1.8分(空间关系:2.3)和w=8 w{=}8 3.5(6.3),尽管两者都低于RepOPE精度(81.3和88.0;基模:92.4);Tab.12中受过双人训练的所有其他变种或臂都损失5.3–9.1分(空间关系:12.0–21.7),大约与VFR的三种种子(5.1–9.7;空间关系:11.0–20.0)一样,而不学习我们对子的臂则像基模一样获得总体收益。

blocks.en: F Evaluation protocols
blocks.zh: F 评价协议

blocks.en:
Pinned software. All scoring uses Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct at revision 0c351dd0 with Transformers 4.57.6 in bf16.
The benchmarks run in VLMEvalKit at commit aec2f4e9 ; HallusionBench, AMBER, RePOPE, VisMin, and NegVQA use their authors’ scorers at pinned commits, and the definitions of MME, MMVP, BLINK, and CV-Bench come from pinned snapshots of their authors’ repositories.
blocks.zh:
平板软件。 所有评分均使用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct在修订0c351dd0时使用变形器4.57.6在bf16.
Hallusion Bench、AMBER、RePOPE、VisMin和NegVQA使用作者的记分符, 以及MME、MMVP、BLINK和CV-Bench的定义来自作者的寄存器被钉住的快照。

blocks.en:
Frozen TEST. Before any training, TEST was read for the release checks of the frozen splits, an audit of their wording cues, and a registered diagnostic of the unadapted base model with the real image, a black image, and noise; later work used only its image identities, to keep them out of other data.
No recorded selection of an adapter or a recipe used TEST.
blocks.zh:
冻腾科技. 在接受任何训练之前,TEST被读作冷冻片的放行检查,对其措辞提示的审计,以及用真实的图像,黑色图像,和噪音对未适应的基模型的注册诊断;后来的工作只使用其图像身份,使其远离其他数据.
没有记录使用 TEST 的适配器或配方选择 。

blocks.en:
Gold construction. Gold pairs are sampled from all 2,569,000 generated pairs of both rounds, regardless of failure or committee outcome, after removing every pair whose image group touches our splits, replay data, other training data, the VisMin training release, or the benchmarks: 904,542 pairs in 66,575 image groups remain.
The author labeled a first sample of 200 pairs per type (seed 20261021; negation balanced between the two answer orders and over its six operators) and then reserves as needed, in an interface that hid the stored labels and model answers, kept the two questions of a pair apart, and repeated 200 questions.
Gold labels are the author’s answers; no adjudication or stored label fills them in.
The frozen set has 747 pairs (150 per type, 147 for object existence); negation has 25 pairs per operator, and half of all questions have the answer Yes .
blocks.zh:
黄金建筑. 黄金对子从所有2,569,000个生成的两轮对子中取样,无论失败或委员会结果如何,在移除了每一对其图像组触动了我们的分裂,重播数据,其他训练数据,VisMin训练发布,或基准:在66,575个图像组中904,542对仍然保留.
作者将首个样片标注为每类200对(种子20261021;否定两个答令之间及其6个操作员之上的平衡),然后根据需要保留,在一个隐藏存储的标签和模型答案的界面中,将一对的两个问题分开,重复了200个问题.
黄金标签是作者的答案;没有裁决或储存的标签填写这些标签。
冷冻套装有747对(每型150对,对象存在147对);否定每个操作员有25对,所有问题中有一半有答案是肯定的。

blocks.en:
Gold labeling outcomes. Of the 1,276 pairs the author labeled, we dropped, by the first matching rule, 359 with a non-binary (“can’t tell”) answer, 1 with an inconsistent answer to a repeated item, and 126 with the same answer to both questions; 43 more fell to other exclusions and the per-type quotas, which leaves 747 ( Tab. 13 ; 64 reserve pairs were never shown).
Spatial pairs are most often unanswerable: the author could not answer 153 of 372 (41.1%), against 15.0–29.6% of the other types’ pairs.
On the 920 pairs with two binary answers, the author’s answers and the stored labels disagree on 153 (16.6%; Wilson 95% interval 14.4–19.2) and on 193 of 2,083 binary answers (9.3%); in the frozen set, 12 of the 747 pairs (1.6%) have both stored labels reversed, a rate for the selected pairs, not for the generator.
These are disagreements, not label errors, since either side may be wrong, and a “can’t tell” answer is not counted as one.
Of the 200 questions shown twice, the two answers agree on 194 (97.0%).
blocks.zh:
黄金标签结果。 在作者所标注的1,276对中,我们按照第一个比对规则,将359对与非二进制的回答(不能说),1对重复的回答不一致,126对两个问题的答复相同;另外还有43对其他排除和每类配额,这留下了747(表13;64对后备对从未显示)。
空间配对往往无法回答:作者无法回答372对中的153对(41.1%),而其他类型配对中的15.0-29.6%。
在包含两个二进制答案的920对中,作者的答案和存储的标签在153(16.6%;威尔逊95%间隔14.4–19.2)和2,083个二进制答案中的193个(9.3%)上存在分歧;在冷冻组中,747对中12对(1.6 %)的存储标签都倒置了,这是选定对子的速率,而不是发电机的速率.
这些是分歧,而不是标签错误,因为任何一方可能都错了,而“不能说”的答案不算为一个。
在两次显示的200个问题中,两个答案都同意194个(97.0%)。

blocks.en: Table 13 : Gold pairs labeled and dropped , by the first matching rule. Other : one inconsistent repeat (object existence), two identity or duplicate exclusions, and 41 pairs beyond the per-type quotas.
blocks.zh: 表13:按首条匹配规则标注并投放的黄金对. 其他:一次不一致的重复(对象存在),两次身份或重复排除,41对超过每类配额.

blocks.en:
Rephrased VAL. Each VAL question is reworded with another template frame for its type, keeping its image and label; for counting, the false number asked is also redrawn, so that true and false numbers share the range 1–7, and the singular/plural contrast is removed.
The design and scoring were registered before any VLM was evaluated on it, with one amendment, which set the range of the false counts.
It re-encodes rather than removes the counting cue: answering Yes exactly when the asked number is one solves 78.7% of the counting pairs in both versions, and the frozen text-only spatial classifier still answers 80.3% of the spatial pairs, so the rephrased set is not cue-free.
blocks.zh:
重译VAL. 每个 VAL 题用另一个模板框重新拼写其类型,保留其图像和标签;为了计算,所询问的假数字也重新绘制,这样真假数字共享范围1-7,并去除单数/平面对比.
设计和评分在评估任何VLM之前已经登记,并做了一项修正,确定了虚假计数的范围。
它重编码而不是删除计数提示: 回答 是的,正值被问号码是1解决了两个版本中78.7%的计数对时,被冻结的文本仅空间分类器仍然解答了80.3%的空间对时,所以重释的集不是无提示的.

blocks.en:
Rewritten gold spatial questions. Each of the 150 gold spatial pairs is rewritten twice from its stored slots: with a paraphrase template from the rephrased VAL above, and as the converse relation, which swaps the two objects and inverts the relation; the gold labels carry over unchanged.
The author reviewed the text of all 600 rewritten questions and answered 50 converse pairs blind from the images; these answers agree with the carried-over labels on 90 of 100 questions and 41 of 50 pairs.
The design and two findings were registered before the rewrites were generated, and the rewrites were frozen before any model saw them: the gain survives a version if VFR’s difference from the base model on it has an interval above zero (it does on both: 87.3% vs . 62.0% and 94.5% vs . 70.0%), and it is tied to our templates if VFR’s change from the original wording has an interval below zero (it is, for the paraphrase).
blocks.zh:
重写金色空间问题. 150个黄金空间对的每对都从其存储的插槽中重写两次:上面重写VAL的释义模板,并作为反向关系,将两个对象互换,颠倒关系;金色标签结转不变.
作者审阅了全部600个重写题的文字,并回答50对相声盲从画面;这些答案与100个题中的90个和50对中的41个的结转标签一致.
在重写之前就已经登记了设计和两个结果,重写在任何模型看到它们之前就被冻结了:如果VFR与它上的基础模型的间隔超过零,则收益会维持在一个版本中(它在两个版本上都是:87.3%对62.0%和94.5%对70.0%),如果VFR与原始措辞的改变的间隔低于零,则收益会与我们的模板捆绑在一起(在解释中)。

blocks.en:
What’sUp. Its two controlled subsets have 820 photos of 205 object pairs, one photo per relation, and none matches an image of ours by source identity, SHA-256, or perceptual hash.
In the yes/no format, each photo gets two questions in our spatial template, one true and one false, and counts as right only if both answers are; in caption choice, the four captions of its subset are offered in four rotated orders, and accuracy is averaged over the orders.
Every caption-choice response is free text, so all of them go to the locked extractor.
The test, both formats, and the breakdowns by relation were registered after the main results and before any model was evaluated on What’sUp; intervals use 2,000 bootstrap draws over the 205 object pairs (seed 20261109).
blocks.zh:
其两个受控子集有205个对象对的820张照片,每个关系各一张照片,没有任何照片与我们从源头身份(SHA-256)或感知散列的图像相符。
在"是/否"格式中,每张照片在我们的空间模板中都会得到两个问题,一个是真实的,一个是假的,只有在两个答案都正确的情况下才算对;在标题选择中,其子集的四个标题以四个旋转的顺序提供,准确性在顺序上平均.
每个字幕选择响应都是免费的文本,所以都去锁定的提取器.
在主要结果之后,在对What ' sUp 的任何模型进行评估之前,对两种格式的测试和按关系分类的测试都进行了登记;间隔使用2,000只靴子绘制205对物体(种子20261109)。

blocks.en:
Held-out benchmarks. Their tiers, scorers, populations, and bootstrap procedure were registered before any adapter was evaluated on them, with contrasts against VFR; the other arms’ contrasts with the base model and the three-seed means were added later.
The official tier uses each benchmark’s own parser; the robust tier scores a response that is exactly one option label directly and sends any other response to the extractor; unresolved responses count as wrong in both.
BLINK is the authors’ macro over its tasks, CV-Bench 2D the mean of its COCO and ADE20K parts, and MME a score, not a percentage.
Items that share an image with any of our training, replay, selection, or development data, by canonical identity, SHA-256, or perceptual hash, are left out together with every item linked to them through a shared image: MME keeps 2,310 of its 2,374 items, CV-Bench 2D 1,260 of 1,438, BLINK 1,772 of 1,901, and CV-Bench 3D and MMVP all of theirs.
Contrasts are paired bootstrap intervals over shared image clusters (2,000 replicates, seed 20261014).
blocks.zh:
搁置基准。 它们的分级、计分器、种群和靴子程序在对其进行任何适配器评价之前就已登记,与VFR形成对比;其他武器与基模的对比和三种子手段后来也加入。
官方级别使用每个基准本身的解析器;强度等级的评分是完全一个选项直接标签的响应,并向提取器发送任何其他响应;未解答的响应在两者中都算错.
BLINK是作者在任务上的宏观,CV-Bench 2D是其CO和ADE20K部件的平均值,MME是得分而不是百分比.
与我们的任何培训、重播、选择或开发数据共用图像的项目,如通过犬科特征的SHA-256或感知散列,则与通过共同图像与之相连的每件物品一起被忽略:MME保存其2,374件物品中的2,310件,1,438件的CV-Bench 2D 1,260件,1,901件的BLINK 1,772件,以及CV-Bench 3D和MVP的所有物品。
对比点是在共享图像集群上配对的靴子间隔(2 000个复制品,种子20261014)。

Which question fails. Tab. 16 gives, for the “on” and “under” photos, how often each of a photo’s two questions is answered yes, first in a post hoc breakdown of the same predictions and then in the two conditions described below.
The photo of a scarf under a table, for example, gets “In the image, is there a scarf under a table?” ( Yes ) and “In the image, is there a scarf on a table?” ( No ).
In these predictions, every model answers yes to nearly every true question (at least 96.1%).
The arms trained on all five of our types fail on one of them: on “under” photos they also answer yes to the false “on” question, VFR for 70.3% of the photos (base model: 11.7%; difference 58.6 points, interval 50.4 to 67.0), Unverified for 97.7%, training without replay for 90.3%, VFR+MI for 79.6%, and random pairs for 50.5% (for each, the interval for the difference from the base model starts at 29.9 points or more).
On “on” photos, none of these arms, averaged over its seeds, answers yes to the false “under” question more often than the base model does (12.6%; VFR: 8.7%, an interval including zero).
VisMin-controlled accepts both false questions more often than the base model (31.7% and 22.3%; intervals above zero), and replay alone and VisMin-native accept the false “on” question no more often (7.8% and 9.1%).
VFR’s yes to the false “on” question is also close to the decision boundary: its mean log-probability margin of yes over no on that question is + 1.3 +1.3 (base model: − 7.5 -7.5 ), against + 7.7 +7.7 on the true “under” question, and for a further 3.1% of the photos the two scores tie, which counts as wrong.
None of the 24,000 repair questions that VFR trains on contains “under”, “underneath”, “beneath”, or “on top of” (“above”: 1,857; “below”: 1,815); of its 12,000 replay rows, 53 contain “under”, 9 of them with a yes/no target (5 yes).

blocks.en:
Other words and no image. We then asked each of these photos’ two questions with the words of our relation pairs, “above” for “on” and “below” for “under”, keeping What’sUp’s relations as labels without re-annotating them, and asked the original questions with a black image, on which every one of them is false (post hoc; specified before the runs).
With “below” and “above”, the base model and every arm of Tab. 15 agree with both carried-over labels for nearly every “under” photo (at least 96.1%; VFR: 99.6%; the run without directional relation pairs described below: 75.7%).
On the “on” photos, where the carried-over “below” label can be ambiguous (a chair’s back, for example, rises above an object on its seat), the base model affirms “below” for 34.0%; averaged over their seeds, the arms trained on all five of our types affirm it less often but deny “above” far more often: VFR affirms it for 46.0% of these photos (base model: 99.0%; difference − 53.0 -53.0 points, interval − 61.2 -61.2 to − 44.9 -44.9 ) and agrees with both labels for 42.5% (base model: 62.1%).
With a black image, the base model answers no to all 412 questions, as do replay alone, random pairs, and the VisMin arms; VFR answers yes to 32.2% of the “on” and 32.8% of the “under” questions (seeds: 15.5–41.7% and 10.7–66.0%), with mean margins near zero ( − 0.5 -0.5 for both; base model: − 13.8 -13.8 and − 11.3 -11.3 ), and Unverified and training without replay answer yes to more than half.
So the false “on” answers depend on the photo, not on the question alone: random pairs answer no to every question on a black image yet affirm the false “on” for half of the “under” photos, and VFR affirms it for 70.3% of those photos against 32.2% of all “on” questions on a black image.
